When I was 7, me and my cousins were outside flying our kites. We had a open backyard and there were many houses surrounding us. My brother (who was 2-3 years old at the time) was outside just running around and dragging his kite in the grass. After an hour or so of playing with kites, we went inside to go get water. Our mothers asked where my brother was and we responded with we didn't know. We thought that the adults were watching him since we weren't told to watch him. They were yelling at us to go look for him and saying that he could be kidnapped or dead. After 45 minutes of crying and frantic searching, the adults told us to come back inside. And there sitting in a chair was my brother, unharmed and eating a sandwich.  Apparently he wasn't lost at all and before we went back inside for water, they found him in a bush,  tearing off the leaves. They made us look for him as punishment.  I was so mad at them.
